name: Lee
gaps: Source query returned 3945 rows; 3908 stayed in the 5.0–150.0 acre band after the parcel-id and geometry checks.

Parcels are Lee County Web Parcels (Parcel_Polygons joined to CAMA, county AGOL) (https://services5.arcgis.com/zg6ovB2KKN8L0zFv/arcgis/rest/services/Web_Parcels/FeatureServer/0). Acreage is 5.0–150.0 inclusive. No Opportunity Zone status, school grade, or base flood elevation is stored.
tax usable: County-published daily CAMA join (Lee County AGOL, data edit 2026-09-24). No single total market/assessed field — sum components.
sale usable: Date is a string YYYYMMDD (not epoch) — parse %Y%m%d.
owner usable: Owner + mailing public; no separate zip field (zip may be embedded or absent).
qPublic and Beacon property-appraiser links are stored as patterns and were not requested.
Owner phone and email are not ingested. SCDOT AADT stays the query-time statewide join.
SCDOT statewide SC_Parcels requires token — not usable as primary.
